name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Audits any website for the technical causes of poor AI discoverability (getting found and cited by AI assistants) and poor on-site engagement (keeping the visitor who arrives), and emits one structured report of evidence-backed findings plus prioritized, mechanism-sound suggested actions. Recommend-only and read-only.

skills.role: Entrypoint. Plans the audit, dispatches the collector and the six detectors, correlates and deduplicates their findings, applies the severity and priority models, and emits the single audit report.

Acquisition. The only skill that makes network requests. Parses robots.txt, discovers URLs, samples deterministically by page template, and dual-fetches each page as a non-rendering crawler and as a browser. Emits snapshot.json.

Detector for the discovered and accessible funnel gates: robots policy by crawler role, noindex, sitemap health, status and redirect integrity, canonical correctness, user-agent differential blocking, gated content.

Detector for the readable funnel gate: client-side-rendering gaps between raw HTML and rendered DOM, facts locked in images or PDFs, content behind interaction, semantic structure, interstitials present in the raw response.

Detector for the understood funnel gate: structured-data presence, parse validity, per-page-type coverage, structured-versus-visible contradictions, organization entity identity, sameAs links, and entity ambiguity risk.

Detector for the retrieved and selected funnel gates: whether a machine can locate and quote the specific fact a question asks for, including answer position, specification extractability, entity naming, units, and heading anchors.

Detector for which version of a fact survives into an answer: intra-site fact conflicts, date-signal integrity, superseded content still live, and optional bounded off-site corroboration of the current facts.

Detector for the post-click stage: deep-link landing integrity, answer proximity for a visitor arriving mid-journey with a specific question, interruption and gating, orientation, continuation, and inbound context preservation.
Uplift. Produces capped, archetype-gated proactive improvements that go beyond detected defects, plus the measurement plan for tracking visibility, factual accuracy and engagement over time.
